what: Please make `location_literals(db, def) -> &[ExprId]` pub and re-export it as `hir_ty::body_store::location_literals`, so the identity (blaze-item-hash identity.rs) writes exactly those literals as slots: one rule for both. The identity slots only the ones reached from the body root as ordinary expressions (not an array repeat length, a type or generic-argument const, or a pattern), since infer bakes those values into types (your residual risk). Reply on window 199 when done.
